name: Administrative Tablet of Grain Rations
key_features: Lists allocations of grain to workers; clear column formatting; seal impression on reverse.
related_objects: Similar ration tablets from the Ur III period
iconography: Cylinder seal impression depicting a seated deity receiving offerings
text:
1. 10 sila še gurush
2. 5 sila še geme
3. 2 sila še dumu
translation: 10 sila of barley for the male worker; 5 sila of barley for the female worker; 2 sila of barley for the child.

name: Hymn to Inanna Tablet
key_features: Literary text praising Inanna; finely incised signs; partial damage on lower edge.
iconography: No seal; clean obverse with dense text
translation: Lady of all the divine powers, Inanna, you alone are exalted; your radiance is great indeed.

name: Mathematical Problem Tablet
key_features: Contains a geometry problem; student exercise; reverse includes teacher correction.
text:
1. 30 uš sag
2. 10 uš šu
3. a-na 3 ta-mar
translation: A rectangle of length 30 and width 10; what is its area? (Answer: 300).

name: Letter from a Merchant
key_features: Private correspondence regarding shipment of tin; envelope fragments preserved.
text:
umma Aššur-iddin ana Ilīya
ṭuppam ša kaspim ušēbilakkum
translation: Thus says Ashur-iddin to Iliya: I have sent you the tablet concerning the silver.

name: Lexical List Tablet
key_features: Bilingual lexical list; used in scribal training; neat column divisions.
iconography: No imagery; structured columns of signs
text:
1. e2 = bītu
2. lugal = šarrum
3. dumu = mārum
translation: House = bītu; King = šarrum; Son = mārum.
